review_kind: Independent Codex/AI semantic review; not human ratings
reviewer_model: GPT-6 (system-provided family identity; exact deployment variant not available)
phase: initial method-hidden ratings; immutable after identity reveal

independence.prior_exposure: User prompt disclosed candidate identity, completed allocation, three historical bug disagreements, and existence of prior source reviews. No prior session report ratings or outcomes were supplied. No key, scorecard, aggregate or measured report was viewed before saving.
independence.anonymization: A mechanical local script read run/results.json solely to match report payload SHA-256 to sheet fingerprints and emit payloads under R codes; no aliases, row outcomes, aggregate results or model mapping were emitted or inspected. Generator review() source was read to locate the payload/fingerprint format.
independence.evidence: All 53 sheet entries, both complete integration inputs, full retained historical openings, and anonymized report context/citations were inspected. Frozen profile template fields corroborate requests; citation links were not independently fetched. No live issue edits, labels or comments used.
independence.scope: Semantic support permits a broad bug label for an actual malfunction while noting missed regression specificity; it is not expected-label accuracy. Quote relevance asks whether the selected span supports the suggested type. Unsupported claims concerns draft factual assertions; usefulness separately penalizes refusal despite clear requests.
